assumptions.service: every request takes exactly s seconds; original api_time is not replayed
assumptions.concurrency: unlimited concurrent requests; no server queue, network overhead or inflight limit
assumptions.schedule: anchor completion + start_delay_s at chain heads; previous completion + gap_after_s within chains; chain_offset_s ignored
assumptions.window: each root arrival is t=0; count actual request send times <= 1500 s
assumptions.root_completion: maximum request completion time within each root, without truncation at 25 minutes
assumptions.quantiles: equal root weights, linear interpolation; request fraction weights every request equally
